senses.gloss: m. (follis, follera; v. next w. a. Sm. Ant. s. v. Senatus) follera, name of a Roman land-tax, adopted by the Persians.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>בב׳ וכרגא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דברלא ארעא וכרגא</he>, read <he>בב׳ ארנונא וכ׳</he>, Ms. M. <he>בכולארא וכ׳</he>, Ms. R. <he>בכלודא וארנונא ואכרגא</he>, corr. acc.) with reference to follera, annona and charga of the ensuing year.
